{{Top|leg}}
The '''Schostri toxin''', produced by the [[Schostri]] [[Insect/Legends|insect]] [[Species/Legends|species]], was dissolved in a liquid by the [[Vagaari Empire]] to create an [[Unidentified airborne poison|airborne]] [[Poison/Legends|poison]] capable of [[Death/Legends|melting]] the soft tissues of every being, including its user, in a 20&ndash;[[Meter/Legends|meter]] radius.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Schostri]] toxin was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
